candidate_program.name: exchange_regime_switch
candidate_program.rationale: Handles isolated contacts directly, credits roots whose reward covers total blocker weight, and discounts contested roots otherwise. Reach is one neighborhood; bounded conditionals add constant arithmetic, with base updates still charged.
candidate_program.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight + 0.5 * (weight - conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + degree + conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
